q: For points $A,B,C,D,E$ in this order on a circle, let $P=BE\cap AC$, $Q=BE\cap AD$. Given $BP=PQ=QE$ and $([BCP],[APQ],[DEQ])=(2,9,3)$, determine $AC/AD$. Here $[XYZ]$ denotes triangle area; intersections use segments.
Maximize the area of an integer-sided rectangle partitioned by full cuts parallel to its sides into pairwise noncongruent rectangles whose side lengths belong to $\{1,\ldots,9\}$.
In parallelogram $ABCD$, take $E\in\operatorname{int}(CD)$, $M=(A+E)/2$, and $F=\operatorname{line}(BM)\cap AD$. Given $(CE,DF,MB,MC)=(3,3,5,4)$, determine $AB$.
On $G=\mathbb{Z}/2026\mathbb{Z}$, define $T_S(i)=i+1$ for $i\in S$, and $T_S(i)=i-2$ otherwise. Count $S\subseteq G$ with $|T_S(G)|=2000$.
Minimize $a_{20}$ over pairwise distinct positive-integer sequences containing $36,3750$ and satisfying $\sum_{k=1}^n(-1)^{k-1}a_k\mid a_{n+1}$ for every $n\ge1$.

Given $AB=AC$, $BC=21$, take interior side-points $D\in BC,E\in CA,F\in AB$ with $\angle EDF=180^\circ-\angle BAC/2$. Set $P=\operatorname{perpBis}(BD)\cap\operatorname{line}(DE)$, $Q=\operatorname{perpBis}(CD)\cap\operatorname{line}(DF)$, $R=\operatorname{line}(BP)\cap\operatorname{line}(CQ)$. Given $(EP,FQ,AR)=(12,16,6\sqrt7)$, determine $[DPQ]$. Here $\operatorname{perpBis}$ denotes perpendicular bisector and brackets denote area.
Find the least positive integer $n$ admitting a strictly convex $101$-gon with cyclic vertices $P_i=(x_i,y_i)\in\{0,\ldots,n\}^2$ and $x_i=y_{i+1}$ (indices modulo $101$).
Count $(a_1,\ldots,a_{26})\in\{1,\ldots,20\}^{26}$ for which exactly one pair $1\le i<j\le26$ satisfies $\sum_{k=1}^ia_k=\sum_{k=j}^{26}a_k$.

Let $ABC$ be acute, $AB<AC$, with circumcenter $O$; its internal angle bisector at $A$ meets $BC$ at $D$. Distinct $P,Q\in\overrightarrow{DO}$ occur in order $D,P,Q$, opposite $B$ across $AC$ and alongside $C$ across $AB$. Given $AB=BP$, $AC=CQ$, $\angle ABP=\angle ACQ$, determine $\angle BAC$.

For positive odd integers $a_n$, suppose $$a_{n+2}=\min\{k\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}:k>a_{n+1},\ k\equiv1\pmod2,\ \gcd(k,a_n)=1\}\qquad(n\ge1).$$ Prove $\exists C\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}\ \forall n\ge1:\ |a_n-2n|\le C$.

For each integer $n\ge2$, minimize $m\ge2n$ admitting disjoint $n$-element vertex subsets $R,B$ of a regular $m$-gon such that $$\{|u-v|:u,v\in R,\ u\ne v\}\cap\{|u-v|:u,v\in B,\ u\ne v\}=\varnothing,$$ where $|u-v|$ is Euclidean distance.

Fix a scalene triangle $ABC\subset\pi\subset\mathbb{R}^3$, with incenter $I$. For $P\notin\pi$ satisfying $AP\cdot BC=BP\cdot CA=CP\cdot AB$, let $I_A,I_B,I_C$ be the incenters of $BCP,CAP,ABP$. Whenever the circumcircles $(II_BI_C),(II_CI_A),(II_AI_B)$ meet $\pi$ again at $X,Y,Z\ne I$, respectively, prove that $XYZ$ has a similarity class independent of $P$.
